text: Friday night. Momo with the gang, and you grab the bill. [amazed] Seventeen hundred rupees? Easy. They'll pay you back.
Three weeks later... you're still waiting. And now it's awkward to ask.
Calculators don't know who ate what.
And nobody wants to be the friend who asks for money.
Meet Split-Up. Bill splitting, the Nepali way.
Add the bill item by item, and tag who had what.
Service charge and VAT? Shared out fairly, down to the paisa.
Or split it equally, by shares, or by percentage.
Everyone sees it live, and debts simplify to the fewest payments.
Settle up with eSewa, Khalti or Fonepay, in a tap.
Add friends with one QR scan. In English, or in Nepali.
No chasing. No awkward texts. Just friends, square again.
Eat together. Split fairly. Stay friends. Split-Up is free, at splitup dot thimitech dot com.
